description: Focused Finance and Compression experiment with thinking enabled, distinct from the canonical non-thinking compression comparison.

compression.transform: remove exactly the leading /no_think followed by two newlines

run_policy: Two passes; add a third for a task if either result is incomplete or the full diagnostic/quality signatures differ. Preserve all passes and failures; no best-of selection.
score_policy: source-aware-v2 semantic judge; missing or truncated answers have null quality scores. This subset is not a /62 leaderboard score.
